execution_message.text: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: two-key-pose game action strip. Image 1 is the ONLY approved character master for identity/style. EXACTLY TWO equal-width horizontal slots LEFT TO RIGHT; one isolated full-body character in each, SAME drawing size/camera/head-body proportions and common source ground plane, generous transparent margins. Genuine alpha, no labels/panel dividers/floor/cast shadow/matte/motion blur. Do not overlap slot borders or clip any extremity. Preserve Soft Handmade 2.5D, warm dark-brown outline, controlled fine pencil/paper grain, soft SCREEN UPPER LEFT light. Do not draw any snack, tray, question mark, glitter, extra prop or duplicate character within a slot. Approved seated orange/cream tabby Cat cat-02: same round head, short seated body, stripe placements, whiskers, pink cheeks and inner ears, brown irises/visible eye whites, small nose, grounded tail curling across FRONT FEET. Both open eyes retain LARGE upper-left white glint and SMALL lower-right glint; never swap to pure Dinosaur eye type or close the eyes. Keep pink pads on the raised ANATOMICAL LEFT paw (viewer RIGHT); other forepaw/feet grounded as reference. Do not lift tail behind the body, change stripes or stretch legs. Pose 0 LEFT SLOT: slight forward reaching motion of the already-raised viewer-right paw to receive an external snack, pink pads visible, no snack drawn; neutral friendly mouth/tongue as reference. Pose 1 RIGHT SLOT: same seated base and tail/feet unchanged, raised left paw comes a little toward chest after receipt; happy friendly slightly wider smile with small rounded pink tongue, same open iris/white eyes and glints. Distinct paw positions, same head/body mass. All four paws accounted for, no extra limb. Receiving hand stays anatomical LEFT in both frames.
